title: Upper gas pressure
description: Essential: Correctly applies Boyle's law to the upper gas to find its final pressure as 2p_0.

title: Lower gas volume
description: Important: Correctly calculates the final volume of the lower gas as (3/2) S L_0.

title: Lower gas pressure
description: Essential: Correctly applies Boyle's law to the lower gas to find its final pressure as (2/3)p_0.

title: Force balance on piston
description: Important: Sets up the vertical force equilibrium equation for the piston, accounting for pressures, weight, and atmospheric pressure.

title: Piston mass calculation
description: Essential: Solves the equilibrium equation correctly to find the piston mass as (4 p_0 S)/(3 g).

title: Misapplied gas law
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes both gases have the same final volume or pressure, or misapplies the isothermal condition.

title: Force direction error
description: Pitfall: Omits the piston's weight, uses incorrect signs for pressure forces, or forgets atmospheric pressure on the rod side.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Explicitly verifies dimensional consistency of the final answer for mass (e.g., [p_0 S / g] has units of mass).
